$comment: Locale posts whose slug predates scripts/lib/_romanise.py and does not re-derive from its title. Frozen, not fixed: the slugs are correct and renaming live URLs to satisfy a test is not a trade worth making. The gate fails on any post outside this set, and on an entry that has started deriving — so it can only shrink. Never add a new post here; new work is held to the deriver exactly.
